item.text: The cache currently stores strings, so an individual cache value cannot be nil. I’m changing it to a map of string pointers so the lookup can handle a present nil value, while removing the map pointer indirection. I also found that the WordPress scan reads a global ignore flag; I’ll switch it to the result’s server configuration.

item.text:
Resolved the WordPress cache and filtering issues. Cache lookups now use the map directly and treat a present nil value as a miss. The scan uses the per-server `IgnoreInactive` setting to exclude plugins and themes with `Status="inactive"` while keeping active ones.

Tests passed: `go test ./wordpress ./report ./models`.
